correctness.rationale: The strict 0<K<=2 sine contraction proves global attraction exactly up to and including the endpoint, excluding in-phase. Near h=1, positive decreasing errors for initial v<=1 give w_n>=w_0+cn; uniform affine-recurrence expansion and summable weighted errors imply the exact crossover (e^{4t}-1)/6. The checker verifies the nontrivial coefficients and finite examples. Finite hitting and in-phase boundary cases are separately excluded as appropriate.
